## Important info

This will clash with any custom skin that modifies Bewitching Janna. 1 file for all chromas.

## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: Bewitching Janna

**Affects**: VFX colors

Done upon request. Adds matching VFX colors to every chroma, base remains the same. You need to own the chroma and choose it in champ select in order to use this mod.
